# LOAD & CLEAN DATA ------------------------------


```{r Load in PANGAS_biomass data}
PANGAS_biomass <- pg_data("10.1594/PANGAEA.963907")

PANGAS_biomass_Data0 <- PANGAS_biomass[[1]]$data
```

```{r Load in PANGAS_density data}
PANGAS_density <- pg_data("10.1594/PANGAEA.963910")

PANGAS_density_Data0 <- PANGAS_density[[1]]$data
```

```{r Clean PANGAS_biomass}
PANGAS_biomass <- PANGAS_biomass_Data0 %>%
  rename(
    event = Event,
    id = ID,
    area = Area,
    latitude = Latitude,
    longitude = Longitude,
    activity = Activity,
    zone = Zone,
    institution = Institution,
    year_initial = `Year obs [a AD] (Initial year)`,
    year_final = `Year obs [a AD] (Final year)`,
    years = `Years [a]`,
    family = Family,
    species = `Species UID`,
    biomass = `Biom [g/m**2] (Estimated based on the abunda...)`,
    sd_biomass = `Std dev [±] (Of mean biomass values, Calcu...)`,
    samples = `Samples [#]`,
    slope = `Slope (Calculated)`,
    p_value = `Prob (Calculated)`,
    slope_se = `Prob std e [±] (Calculated)`,
    biomass_min = `Biom [g/m**2] (Minimum of biomass. Estimated...)`,
    biomass_max = `Biom [g/m**2] (Maximum of biomass. Estimated...)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_mid = (year_initial + year_final) / 2
  )

```

```{r Clean PANGAS_density}
colnames(PANGAS_density_Data0)

PANGAS_density <- PANGAS_density_Data0 %>%
  rename(
    event = Event,
    id = ID,
    area = Area,
    latitude = Latitude,
    longitude = Longitude,
    activity = Activity,
    zone = Zone,
    institution = Institution,
    year_initial = `Year obs [a AD] (Initial year)`,
    year_final = `Year obs [a AD] (Final year)`,
    years = `Years [a]`,
    family = Family,
    species = `Species UID`,
    density = `Ind a [#/m**2] (Mean density. Estimated based...)`,
    sd_density = `Std dev [±] (Of mean density values, Calcu...)`,
    samples = `Samples [#]`,
    slope = `Slope (Calculated)`,
    p_value = `Prob (Calculated)`,
    slope_se = `Prob std e [±] (Calculated)`,
    density_min = `Ind a [#/m**2] (Minimum of density. Estimated...)`,
    density_max = `Ind a [#/m**2] (Maximum of density. Estimated...)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_mid = (year_initial + year_final) / 2
  )

```


# REVIEW DATA ------------------------------

```{r Simple plots}
plot(PANGAS_biomass$slope)

plot(PANGAS_density$slope)
```

```{r Summary stats}
summary(PANGAS_biomass$biomass, na.rm= TRUE)
summary(PANGAS_biomass$slope, na.rm= TRUE) # Slope seems to be generally increasing
summary(PANGAS_biomass$slope_se)

```


```{r Summarize slope by species and zone}
colnames(PANGAS_biomass)

species_zone_biomass_slope <- PANGAS_biomass %>%
  group_by(zone, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

species_zone_density_slope <- PANGAS_density %>%
  group_by(zone, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r mean plots}

ggplot(
  species_zone_biomass_slope,
  aes(x = species, y = mean_slope, fill = species)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ zone) +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Mean biomass slope (g/m²/year)",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


ggplot(
  species_zone_density_slope,
  aes(x = species, y = mean_slope, fill = species)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ zone) +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Mean density slope (g/m²/year)",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```

```{r What if we filter by years available?}
is.numeric(PANGAS_biomass$year_mid)
```

```{r Summarize slope by species and zone but filter for more recent data sets}
species_zone_biomass_slope <- PANGAS_biomass %>%
  filter(year_final>= 2015) %>%
  group_by(zone, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

species_zone_density_slope <- PANGAS_density %>%
  filter(year_final>= 2015) %>%
  group_by(zone, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Simple plots}
plot(species_zone_biomass_slope$mean_slope)

plot(species_zone_density_slope$mean_slope)
```

# Let's try a new approach:
```{r}
library(dplyr)

dat <- PANGAS_biomass %>%
  mutate(
    assessment_period = case_when(
      year_mid < 2015 ~ "Pre-2015",
      year_mid >= 2015 ~ "Post-2015",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    assessment_period = factor(
      assessment_period,
      levels = c("Pre-2015", "Post-2015")
    )
  )

table(dat$assessment_period)
 # Pre-2015 Post-2015 
 #      325       117

table(dat$assessment_period, dat$zone)
table(dat$assessment_period, dat$family)

```


```{r Viz}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(
  dat %>% filter(!is.na(slope), !is.na(assessment_period)),
  aes(x = assessment_period, y = slope)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.35,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Estimated biomass slope (g/m²/year)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r Model}
dat_test <- dat %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(slope),
    !is.na(assessment_period)
  )

mod <- lm(
  slope ~ assessment_period + family + zone,
  data = dat_test
)

summary(mod)
#                            Estimate Std. Error t value  Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)                 2.64525    0.59201   4.468 0.0000101 ***
# assessment_periodPost-2015 -0.32220    0.60092  -0.536   0.59211    
# familyGirellidae            0.90343    1.05669   0.855   0.39304    
# familyKyphosidae            0.08168    1.05669   0.077   0.93842    
# familyPomacentridae        -1.32344    0.72186  -1.833   0.06743 .  
# familyScaridae             -0.40456    0.66831  -0.605   0.54527    
# zoneNorth                  -0.93533    0.61354  -1.524   0.12812    
# zoneSouth                  -1.92226    0.67104  -2.865   0.00438 ** 

# No compelling evidence of an effect of period...

```

```{r}
dat %>%
  select(year_initial, year_final, year_mid) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(year_initial, year_final)

```

```{r Look into COBI inverts data}
COBI_Invert_Data0<- read.csv("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/COBI/COBI_Invertebrados_Reserva_Biosfera_IslaSanPedroMartir_2007_2022.csv")
```

```{r Clean df}
colnames(COBI_Invert_Data0)

COBI_Invert_Data<- COBI_Invert_Data0 %>%
  select(
    Site = SITIO,
    Day = DIA,
    Month = MES,
    Year = ANIO,
    State = ESTADO,
    Lat = LATITUD,
    Lon = LONGITUD,
    Depth_start = PROFUNDIDAD_INICIAL,
    Depth_end = PROFUNDIDAD_FINAL,
    Species = ESPECIE,
    Abudance = ABUNDANCIA
  )
```

```{r Summarize}
COBI_Invert_Data_summarized<- COBI_Invert_Data %>%
  select(Year, Species, Abudance) %>%
  group_by(Year, Species) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_Abudance = mean(Abudance, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r Plot summary data}
ggplot(
  COBI_Invert_Data_summarized,
  aes(x = Year, y = mean_Abudance)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Species, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 2015,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r Enhance this plot}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Calculate LM p-value separately for each species
species_lm <- COBI_Invert_Data_summarized %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    n_years = n_distinct(Year[!is.na(Year) & !is.na(mean_Abudance)]),
    slope = if (n_years >= 2) {
      coef(lm(mean_Abudance ~ Year))["Year"]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    p_value = if (n_years >= 2) {
      summary(lm(mean_Abudance ~ Year))$coefficients["Year", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trend = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "Insufficient data",
      p_value < 0.10 & slope < 0 ~ "Significant decline",
      p_value < 0.10 & slope > 0 ~ "Significant increase",
      TRUE ~ "No significant trend"
    )
  )


# Add significance information back to the data
COBI_plot <- COBI_Invert_Data_summarized %>%
  left_join(species_lm, by = "Species")

# Plot
ggplot(
  COBI_plot,
  aes(x = Year, y = mean_Abudance)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = trend),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(color = trend),
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Species, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 2015,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    "Significant decline" = "#D73027",
    "Significant increase" = "#1A9850",
    "No significant trend" = "grey70",
    "Insufficient data" = "grey90"
  )
) + 

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```
